problems.title: Appointment reminders arrive late or at the wrong time
No way to reschedule; cancelling to rebook loses the slot
Payment charged twice when the app times out at checkout
Doctor search ignores the language-spoken filter
Can't book for family members from one account
Video consult link fails on Android in-app browser
Prescription PDF downloads blank or won't open
Clinic staff can't see notes patients add when booking
No reschedule option; cancelling loses the slot
problems.description: The only way to change an appointment is to cancel and rebook. Slots are often gone by then, and users must refill the whole form each time.
problems.persona: Patient needing to change appointment time, including shift workers

problems.title: Language filter ignored in doctor search
problems.description: The language filter doesn't change results, so doctors who don't speak the chosen language are shown. Patients have booked doctors they couldn't talk to.
problems.persona: Patient needing a doctor who speaks their language, or booking for a relative

problems.title: SMS reminders arrive after appointment, causing unfair no-show fees
problems.description: SMS reminders are sent about an hour after the appointment start, so patients miss the visit and are then charged a no-show fee. Affected patients ask for refunds.

problems.title: Clinic details missing: hours, parking, insurance
problems.description: The app doesn't show clinic opening hours, parking or accepted insurance. Users have to ask support.
problems.persona: Patient choosing or visiting a clinic

problems.title: Duplicate charges after payment error or frozen screen
problems.description: After a payment error or frozen screen, users retry and are charged twice for one consultation. They need refunds for the duplicate.

problems.title: Cannot book or manage appointments for family members
problems.description: Users can't book for a spouse or child, and the clinic gets the booker's name. Caregivers managing parents must switch between separate accounts.
problems.persona: Parent or caregiver booking for family members

problems.title: Can't find itemised receipt or upload referral letter
problems.description: Users can't find where to get an itemised receipt for employer claims or where to upload a GP referral letter.
problems.persona: Patient with a claim or referral

problems.title: Reminder time wrong or late, possibly time zone handling
problems.description: Reminder texts show a different time than the app, and for travelers reminders come late, apparently because of time zone handling. Users don't know which time is right.
problems.persona: Patient with upcoming appointment, including those who travel between cities

problems.title: No dark mode; white screen harsh at night
problems.description: Users ask for a dark mode because the bright white screen is harsh at night.

problems.title: Checkout times out on mobile data but money is taken
problems.description: Checkout spins forever and fails on mobile data, yet the payment is taken. Users hit this repeatedly.

problems.title: Video consult fails to open on Android
problems.description: On Android phones the video consult page shows a spinner, a blank screen, or endless camera permission prompts. Patients can't join and must phone the clinic.

problems.title: Push notifications for appointments arrive the next morning
problems.description: Push notifications about appointments are delivered the next morning, making them useless for the appointment.

problems.title: Prescription PDF blank or download does nothing
problems.description: Prescriptions either download as blank PDFs or the download button does nothing, so patients can't get them to the pharmacy.
problems.persona: Patient needing a prescription from a visit

problems.title: App loading slowly
problems.description: Several users report the app loading slowly and ask whether there is an outage.

problems.title: Password reset email never arrives
problems.description: Users can't log in because the reset email never arrives, even after checking spam.

problems.title: Booking notes (allergies, accessibility) never reach the clinic
problems.description: Clinics don't see the notes patients add when booking. Allergy and wheelchair access information is missed.
problems.persona: Patient with medical or accessibility needs

problems.title: WELCOME10 promo code rejected as invalid
problems.description: Users report the WELCOME10 promo code always says invalid.
problems.persona: New user applying a promo code

problems.title: Wrong clinic map pin location
problems.description: The map pin for some clinics is on the wrong street, which could send patients to the wrong place.
